verdict.rationale: Signifyd's Decision Center lets merchants configure policies at the Sale checkpoint, and these are applied automatically to orders created through the Sale event endpoint. That is a product-native rule-on-event mechanism. Webhooks also fire on every guarantee decision, but this is only a built-in event notification, not a user-defined rule. Missing for 10: documentation of how rules and conditions are authored, which actions a policy can trigger, rule coverage at other checkpoints (Checkout, chargeback and similar events), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: If Decision Center is enabled, policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, and they will be applied to orders created via requests to this endpoint.
Signifyd can send a webhook to notify your online store every time a guarantee decision is made on a submitted order.
